Named one by one, only the blocks that census saw as ground and judged, because any word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not. Blunite's polished forms, slabs, stairs and walls were not judged and are left to the rules; the carpeted grass blocks already wear as grass by detection.

Stone: blunite is solid natural rock the mod lays in the overworld's ground, which the rules leave out for having no stone word. End: black dylium is the living surface of the End's own ground, as nylium is the Nether's.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 1.20.1 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was.
